In 2007, Saruhan Deutschland Holding was established in Germany, forming a strategic partnership with Germany-based Fakir Holding. From that point on, all design and engineering processes began taking place in Turkey. To support further expansion, HSVO Design and Software was founded in 2023, providing services across various brands and industries. Today, the HSVO team provides comprehensive design and software solutions to all brands under Saruhan Holding, including official product designs for Fakir Hausgeräte.
